title: Suzu Travels — India's 45 UNESCO World Heritage Sites
_status: spec only 2026-10-07 (scheduled run blocked at setup-motion.sh) — needs photos + proposed/mg-mosaic.patch, then lint/snapshot/render
_music_note: Last two reels used Our Story Begins (kerala) and Vadodora (dmc). Magistar = grand/cinematic, fits heritage. Fallback: Noble Race.

_sources.count: Wikipedia 'List of World Heritage Sites in India' (fetched 2026-10-07): 45 sites = 37 cultural, 7 natural, 1 mixed (Khangchendzonga NP, 2016). Sarnath ('Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath') inscribed 2026 at the 48th WHC session as India's 45th — also Drishti IAS 27 Jul 2026, Outlook Traveller. Official page whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/in could not be opened this run (permission timeout) — re-check before posting.
_sources.years: Wikipedia list: Taj Mahal 1983, Agra Fort 1983, Ajanta 1983, Ellora 1983, Konark 1984, Mahabalipuram 1984, Kaziranga 1985, Hampi 1986, Fatehpur Sikri 1986, Mountain Railways 1999, Jantar Mantar Jaipur 2010, Western Ghats 2012, Hill Forts of Rajasthan 2013 (includes Amber Fort), Rani-ki-Vav 2014, Great Himalayan NP 2014, Khangchendzonga 2016, Jaipur City 2019, Sarnath 2026
_sources.tip: 'Agra + Jaipur = 6 UNESCO sites' = Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri, Jaipur City, Jantar Mantar, Amber Fort (part of Hill Forts of Rajasthan). Phrased as a Suzu tip.
